scenario: A pharmacovigilance analyst prepares a post-marketing safety review memo for a proposed real-world-evidence cohort protocol evaluating co-prescribing of azithromycin (macrolide antibiotic) and sotalol (Class III antiarrhythmic). The pipeline processes the RWE protocol query, normalizes and standardizes the drug safety annotation dataset, evaluates DDI severity and QT-interval additive risk, and produces a structured DDI safety review memo for regulatory submission.
info_flow: clinical-data-cleaner standardizes the RWE protocol drug annotation CSV (normalizing QTc delta values and QT risk tier labels) → drug-interaction-checker evaluates the DDI severity and QT risk for the flagged drug pair → health-report composes the formal DDI safety review memo summarizing individual drug risks and overall co-administration classification.
